science.explanation: The Consciousness Download Interface V1 is a hypothetical device that aims to transfer human consciousness into a digital format, enabling seamless interaction between humans and machines.
assumptions: The human brain can be reduced to a set of computational processes
Digital systems can replicate the complexity of human thought
